# secobserve_parsers (Data Source)

Lists the vulnerability scanner parsers available on the instance, optionally filtered by type and source. Useful to discover the exact parser names to feed into `secobserve_parser`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Discover which parsers can be driven by an API import configuration.
data "secobserve_parsers" "api" {
  source = "API"
}

output "api_parser_names" {
  value = [for parser in data.secobserve_parsers.api.parsers : parser.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `source` (String) Only return parsers with this source: `API`, `File`, `Manual`, `Other` or `Unknown`.
- `type` (String) Only return parsers of this category: `SCA`, `SAST`, `DAST`, `IAST`, `Secrets`, `Infrastructure`, `Other` or `Manual`.

### Read-Only

- `parsers` (Attributes List) Matching parsers, ordered as returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parsers))

<a id="nestedatt--parsers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parsers`

Read-Only:

- `class_name` (String) Python class implementing the parser.
- `id` (Number) Numeric id of the parser.
- `module_name` (String) Python module implementing the parser.
- `name` (String) Name of the parser.
- `sbom` (Boolean) Whether the parser consumes an SBOM.
- `source` (String) How observations reach SecObserve.
- `type` (String) Scanner category.
